newsitem.title: FINLAND: EFORE SAYS MARKET OUTLOOK EXCELLENT.
newsitem.headline: EFORE SAYS MARKET OUTLOOK EXCELLENT.

text.p: Finnish data systems group Efore Oy said on Tuesday the market outlook for its products was excellent and that it was possible to improve profitability and reach the growth rate of previous years.

"The investments and efforts already implemented make it possible to improve profitability and reach the growth track of previous years," it said in a statement with its results for the financial year to end-October.

"Growth on Efore's main market remains strong, so the outlook for Efore's products can be considered excellent," it said, adding that it would aim to operate closer to its clients and make production more efficient.
Efore which makes components for the electronics industry posted a 4.19 million markka profit before extraordinary items in the year to end-October, down from 19.12 million in the previous year.
